His denial does not independently establish whether multiple AI safety organizations arranged retweets of his resignation post [e7]. The interview also does not establish his full statement record through September 14 [e7]. It therefore cannot settle the subsidiary allegation that he made no direct criticisms beyond calls for more safety or a coordinated global slowdown [e7].
limitations: No authenticated communications or organizational records establish or exclude the alleged retweet arrangements.
The packet does not distinguish personal assistance from actions on behalf of organizations.

statement.excerpt: Retweets of his post were clearly coordinated with various AI safety organizations, and the speed at which it took off with the media makes all of this look incredibly contrived
statement.document_title: AI Is Already In Dangerous Hands

from_speaker: Retweets of his post were clearly coordinated
total lack of any direct critiques or “blown whistles”
other than that they “can do more safety” and “should coordinate a global slowdown”
our_interpretation: The central testable allegation is an arrangement to amplify the resignation post involving multiple AI safety organizations or representatives acting for them.
Coordination need not involve payment or occur before publication. Requests to organize retweets after publication could qualify.
Rapid sharing, shared donors and overlapping friendships do not alone establish an arrangement.
Looks contrived is an impression, not a separately scored factual allegation.
The subsidiary lack-of-criticism allegation requires distinguishing general safety warnings, which Zitron expressly excludes, from specific criticisms or disclosures.
The target is the September resignation-post episode through the September 14 publication date; the supplied passage does not specify its exact starting day.
criteria.support_condition: Authenticated messages, organizational disclosures or reliable firsthand reporting establish coordinated retweets involving multiple safety organizations. The subsidiary claim requires a sufficiently complete record of Coxon's statements through publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish independent amplification without the alleged arrangements, or contemporaneous statements identify specific criticisms outside the stated exceptions. A denial alone does not settle coordination.
